# xyops_category (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xyops_category" "general" {
  title   = "General"
  enabled = true
  color   = "blue"
  icon    = "folder"
  notes   = "Managed by Terraform"
  actions = jsonencode([])
  limits  = jsonencode([])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `actions` (String)
- `color` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `icon` (String)
- `limits` (String)
- `notes` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xyops_category.general general
```
